synth.notes:
Blocks (block mode): A1/A2 move both y-4/y+4; A3 apart, A4 together (mirrored x). Each block is blocked on its own by its half's bounds, maze cells {(6,18),(14,38),(38,14)} and marker cells.
Click on an inactive marker: it becomes active (color_11) and the blocks become armed color_1 players. Click on the active marker: no-op. Click on a player: back to blocks, markers inactive.
Armed mode: A1-A4 move the active marker by 4; it is blocked by maze, marker and player cells. A5 only advances the timer.
Bars: two color_0 1px bars with w=floor(3(a+1)/7), a = actions since level start. a is tracked under exact-state continuity; fallback is the smallest a for the bar width. Names = type_color_rank by (y,x); block_left/right take ranks 0,1.
Open: maze cells beyond the inferred ones, and marker bounds, are unconfirmed.
